caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular area bordered by a wide, uneven grayish frame, set on a beige background. Within this rectangle, the central composition features a depiction of what appears to be layered, concentric circles and arcs resembling coiled or spiraled material. The circular forms in the upper portion of the image have multiple bands of color, including brown, beige, white, pale blue, orange, dark red, yellow, and gray, with each band alternating in thickness. The pattern radiates outward and partially extends beyond the upper left corner of the framed area. The lower portion of the drawing shows semi-circular arcs that continue this striped pattern in horizontal curves, combining shades of pink, blue, green, orange, purple, yellow, brown, and black. The variety of colors are repeatedly used in parallel bands, producing a visually continuous and textured effect. The overall composition resembles a patch or swatch of striped and coiled woven or stitched fabric set against a neutral framed background.
title: Shaker Circular Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
